description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}, targeting any creature you control.
Alela triggers, creating three 1/1 Faerie creature tokens with flying.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Faerie tokens, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
